verdict: Spend collapsed from $13.63 daily average to $3.85 latest, leaving the PCOS and Postpartum campaign starved.
diagnosis: Only one campaign ran this period, burning $2,330 with no visible leads, conversions, or organic support to judge return.

signals.headline: Total spend hit $2,330 this period
signals.detail: All budget went to one Facebook lead campaign targeting PCOS and postpartum personas. No diversification, no backup channel.

signals.headline: Daily spend fell 72% to $3.85
signals.detail: Latest daily spend dropped far below the $13.63 period average. Meta likely cannot exit the learning phase at that level.

signals.headline: Zero data across four core channels
signals.detail: Google Business Profile, organic social, CRM pipeline, and top performers all blank. You are flying blind on lead quality.

signals.headline: One campaign carries 100% of paid
signals.detail: Persona targeting is smart but concentration risk is high. One creative fatigue cycle wipes out the entire funnel.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.body: Premium and boutique studios on Meta typically pay between $25 and $50 per lead. Fitness converts at roughly 14%, the highest of any tracked industry, so lead quality matters more than raw volume.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: August summer peak, cost pressure rising
seasonal.body: Facebook cost per thousand impressions for fitness hit a July 2026 peak of $29.68, up 44% from June. August auctions remain elevated before the September back-to-routine push.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.subheader: Studios pivot to retention and community
competitor.body: Operators in 2026 are shifting budget from acquisition toward retention, habit coaching, and community programming. Acquiring a new member costs 5 to 25 times more than keeping one.

recommendations.title: Restore daily spend to a testable floor
recommendations.detail: Consider returning to at least $15 to $30 per day so Meta can exit the learning phase. Sub-$5 days give the algorithm nothing to optimize against.

recommendations.title: Connect a CRM to measure lead quality
recommendations.detail: Worth wiring the lead form to a pipeline view. Without booked-consult or trial-conversion data, judging the PCOS and postpartum campaign is guesswork.

recommendations.title: Test a second creative angle alongside personas
recommendations.detail: Consider one additional campaign, such as a low-barrier trial offer or community angle. Single-campaign concentration risks total pause when this creative fatigues.
